purpose: Backend-driven SHRESTA storefront home route rendered from the SHRESTA-BE home merchandising API.
businessRules: Do not introduce client-trusted pricing or inventory state here.
Copy must describe SHRESTA as a saree-focused brand.
Brand, navigation, hero, trust, collection, bestseller, material, newsletter, footer, mobile navigation, and customer shell copy must come from GET /api/v1/storefront/home.
Images must render through ResponsiveMedia using backend-provided variants, LQIP, dimensions, and versioned URLs.
Backend network failures and backend API 404 responses render StorefrontBackendUnavailable; other errors must not be swallowed.
aiHint: Keep this route free of frontend-owned datasets. The visual style follows the old SHRESTA reference, but every data-bearing surface is fed by SHRESTA-BE.
